sentences.text: This application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Fategarh P.S. Case No. 17 of 2018 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No. 92 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Nayagarh registered under Sections 363/34 of IPC and later turned to Sections 363, 366, 376-2 (n) and 376 (3) of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

2. Considering the submission of Ms. B. Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner that the accused has married the victim who is a major by now, issue notice to informant-opposite party No.2 by Registered Post with A.D.
Requisites shall be filed within three working days.
The notice shall be made returnable within four weeks.

Learned counsel for the petitioner shall also serve an extra copy of the brief on Mr. A.P. Das,
learned Additional Standing Counsel within three working days for service of notice on opposite party no.2 through the concerned I.O./I.I.C, who shall also inform the opposite party no.2 about the date of the posting of the case and that he/she can appear in Court through counsel or from the Police Station through Video Conferencing to oppose/ support the prayer for bail.
(Savitri Ratho) Judge puspa Signed by: PUSPANJALI MOHAPATRA
